coursesPage.metaDescription: Explore practical courses in cooking, wellness, parenting, money skills, employment, digital literacy, English, safety, and healthy relationships.
coursesPage.title: Courses
coursesPage.intro: Build new skills, gain confidence and create better opportunities. Our courses are designed to support individuals and families with practical, real-world knowledge for everyday life.
coursesPage.exploreIntro: Click on a course to learn more. Each course includes a description, who it is for, learning outcomes and other important details.
coursesPage.mentalHealthNote: This course is educational. It is not a substitute for professional diagnosis, treatment, or emergency care.

shared.instructor: Instructor or facilitator information will be provided with each scheduled course.
shared.schedule: Course dates, schedule and duration will be listed when available.
shared.accessibility: Available accessibility supports and accommodations will be listed with the course details.

cooking.title: Cooking and Nutrition
cooking.summary: Learn practical cooking skills and make healthier, more balanced meals.
cooking.tagline: Learn practical cooking skills and make healthier, more balanced meals for you and your family.
cooking.description: This course introduces practical cooking and nutrition skills to help individuals and families prepare simple, balanced and affordable meals. It focuses on everyday food preparation, healthy choices and meal planning.
cooking.audience: Individuals, parents, families and anyone interested in improving their cooking skills and understanding basic nutrition.

mentalHealth.title: Mental Health and Self-Care
mentalHealth.summary: Build skills for better mental well-being, stress management and everyday self-care.
mentalHealth.tagline: Build skills for better mental well-being, stress management and everyday self-care.
mentalHealth.description: This course offers practical ways to support mental well-being in daily life. It covers stress, routines, and self-care choices that people can use at their own pace.
mentalHealth.audience: Adults and caregivers who want practical tools for mental well-being, stress, and everyday self-care.
outcomes: Notice signs of stress and overwhelm
Build a support plan for difficult days
Know where to find further help

parenting.title: Parenting and Child Development
parenting.summary: Support your child's growth with practical tools for positive parenting.
parenting.tagline: Support your child's growth with practical tools for positive parenting.
parenting.description: This course shares practical ideas for supporting a child's growth, communication, and daily routines. It respects different family structures and parenting styles.
parenting.audience: Parents, caregivers, and family members who want practical tools for positive parenting and child development.
outcomes: Respond to challenging moments with care

budgeting.title: Budgeting and Financial Literacy
budgeting.summary: Learn to manage money, create budgets and build a brighter financial future.
budgeting.tagline: Learn to manage money, create budgets and build a brighter financial future.
budgeting.description: This course introduces everyday money skills, including budgeting, spending choices, and planning ahead. It uses plain language and realistic examples.
budgeting.audience: Individuals and families who want to feel more confident managing money and planning for the future.
outcomes: Plan for bills and unexpected costs

resume.title: Resume and Interview Preparation
resume.summary: Get support to build your resume and prepare for interviews.
resume.tagline: Get support to build your resume and prepare for interviews.
resume.description: This course helps people present their skills clearly on a resume and feel more prepared for interviews. It focuses on strengths, experience, and practical practice.
resume.audience: Job seekers and anyone preparing a resume or getting ready for an interview.
outcomes: Plan next steps in a job search

workplace.title: Workplace Skills
workplace.summary: Develop the skills for today's workplace and explore new opportunities.
workplace.tagline: Develop the skills for today's workplace and explore new opportunities.
workplace.description: This course covers communication, teamwork, and workplace expectations that help people explore new opportunities with more confidence.
workplace.audience: People entering the workforce, changing jobs, or building confidence at work.
outcomes: Work with others on shared tasks

digital.title: Digital Literacy
digital.summary: Gain confidence using computers, online tools and digital services.
digital.tagline: Gain confidence using computers, online tools and digital services.
digital.description: This course builds comfort with computers, email, and everyday online services. It moves at a supportive pace and explains each step in plain language.
digital.audience: Anyone who wants more confidence using computers, phones, and online services.
outcomes: Use a computer or device with more ease
Know how to get help with technology

english.title: English-Language Support
english.summary: Improve your English language skills for daily life, work and community involvement.
english.tagline: Improve your English language skills for daily life, work and community involvement.
english.description: This course supports everyday English for life, work, and community. Practice focuses on listening, speaking, reading, and writing in real situations.
english.audience: People who want to strengthen English for daily life, work, and community involvement.
outcomes: Build vocabulary for work and community

safety.title: Personal Safety
safety.summary: Learn practical safety tips, awareness and how to access support.
safety.tagline: Learn practical safety tips, awareness and how to access support.
safety.description: This course shares practical safety information and ways to access support. Content is presented with care and people can step out at any time.
safety.audience: Adults who want practical safety information and clear ways to reach support.
outcomes: Make a simple personal safety plan
Know local ways to ask for help
Find supports that fit your needs

relationships.title: Healthy Relationships
relationships.summary: Build stronger communication and create respectful, healthy relationships.
relationships.tagline: Build stronger communication and create respectful, healthy relationships.
relationships.description: This course explores communication, respect, and boundaries in relationships. It supports people to build connections that feel safe and mutual.
relationships.audience: Adults who want stronger communication and more respectful, healthy relationships.
outcomes: Know where to find relationship support

story.title: Our Story
story.description: Make A Difference brings education, practical assistance, employment support, community participation, and donations together in one accessible platform. We support women, children, LGBTQ2S+ individuals, and families by connecting them to the resources, opportunities, and community they need to build stronger, healthier, and more inclusive lives across Canada.
story.imageAlt: Caregiver and child sharing a moment together outdoors
story.imagePlaceholder: Photo placeholder. The Our Story image will be added here.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To empower women, children, LGBTQ2S+ individuals, and families through inclusive education, practical resources, employment support, and compassionate community programs.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: A more inclusive and equitable Canada where every individual and family has the opportunity to learn, grow, belong, and build a brighter future.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: Our work is guided by a shared set of values that shape how we support our communities and create lasting change.

leadership.title: Leadership and Board
leadership.description: Make A Difference is guided by a dedicated team and board who are committed to advancing our mission and creating meaningful, lasting change. Our leaders bring diverse experience and a shared passion for building stronger, more inclusive communities.

partners.title: Community Partners
partners.description: We are proud to work alongside community partners who share our commitment to stronger, healthier, and more inclusive communities. Together, we expand access to resources, create new opportunities, and make a greater impact.
